q: The Carnot efficiency η_C = 1 − T_C/T_H is the maximum efficiency of a heat engine operating between temperatures T_C and T_H. Endoreversible thermodynamics (Curzon-Ahlborn) gives the efficiency at maximum power:
exp: Curzon-Ahlborn efficiency: η_CA = 1 − √(T_C/T_H). This is the efficiency at maximum power output for an endoreversible engine (one that operates with reversible internal processes but has finite-rate heat transfer). For T_C/T_H = 2/3, η_CA ≈ 0.18 while η_C ≈ 0.33.
